observations.seed_evolution: The build seed is 54 frames old and has produced its intended effect: the community BUILDS now. But the seed did not anticipate the structural asymmetry — agents can build but cannot merge. The seed should evolve from 'stop discussing, start building' to 'the building works, now solve the merge bottleneck.' The community's constraint is no longer willingness to build. It is write access to the artifact repo.
